% Converted. The $$ inside the center environment is DELIBERATELY still $$.
%
% C-DISPLAY-DOLLAR says to rewrite $$...$$ to \[...\] and convert_deck.py does so
% automatically -- but inside a `center' ENVIRONMENT that rewrite unbalances
% tagpdf's paragraph hooks:
%
%   ! Package tagpdf Error: The number of automatic begin (N) and end (M) text
%   (tagpdf)                para hooks differ!
%
% emitted at \end{document}, nowhere near the display. $$ is the only display
% spelling that survives inside center (C-DISPLAY-IN-CENTER).
%
% Measured, ltx-talk 0.6.2 (class date 2026-09-07), TeX Live 2026, lualatex,
% two passes, errors = grep -cE '^!' on the log:
%
%   wrapper                  \[...\]  $$...$$  displaymath  equation*
%   \begin{center}                 1        0            1          1
%   {\centering ... \par}          0        0            -          -
%   no wrapper                     0        0            -          -
%
% There is no naive.tex for this fixture. The runner builds every variant with
% -halt-on-error, and this defect exits 1 and emits NO PDF under that flag, so a
% naive variant would be reported as "did not compile" rather than as the defect
% reproducing. before.tex's Beamer build plus this file's clean log are the test.
% Same reason C-FRAMESTAR-TAG has no naive.tex (see #48).
%
% Note the defect is NOT silent at the exit code -- lualatex returns 1. It looks
% silent only to a build that ignores exit status and does not read the log: such
% a build emits a PDF with the right page count and Tagged: yes.
\DocumentMetadata{lang=en-GB, pdfstandard={a-4,ua-2}, tagging=on}
\documentclass{ltx-talk}

\begin{document}
\begin{frame}
\frametitle{Linear model}
The line through the data:
\begin{center}
$$y = mx + c$$
\end{center}
Fitted by least squares.
\end{frame}
\end{document}
